failure_patterns.pattern: cache_write_omission: Search or filter results were generated without being saved for reuse.

rejected_edits.content: - Interpret replies in light of the immediately preceding assistant clarification or proposal and any pending request. If the assistant explicitly asks for preferences or criteria for a search domain and the user answers with concrete criteria, treat that answer as authorization to search or update that domain when its required inputs are complete, even if the user does not repeat its name. Apply a supplied missing criterion or location to the earlier pending domain rather than treating the reply as a no-op. Resolve brief affirmations such as “yes” against the proposal and carry forward its stated entity, category, preference, or action. If a single reply provides multiple distinct locations for one request, run a separate search or filter for each location; for cached results, start each filter from the same compatible base rather than combining locations in one scalar field or sequentially narrowing one result with another.
rejected_edits.target: - Resolve brief affirmations such as “yes” against the immediately preceding assistant question or proposal, and carry forward the proposed entity or category as stated.

rejected_edits.content: - On each turn, map the current request and any still-pending request it answers against the full conversation and cache, then execute only those requested actions. Reuse cached results only when their domain and subject match; search for a requested entity or category that the cache does not cover. For a follow-up criterion or location, retrieve the latest compatible result for only that domain and subject, apply only the newly stated criterion or criteria, and save the transformed result. When a criterion applies to multiple explicitly requested itinerary legs, filter each leg’s compatible results independently rather than launching replacement searches or sequentially narrowing one leg’s results with another. Assign every results-producing search, filter, sort, or `search_nearest` call to a variable and immediately save that result under a unique cache key; do not resave an unchanged cached item. Avoid retrieving unrelated results or repeating constraints already applied. Use “No planning needed” only when cached results already satisfy every current request.
rejected_edits.target: - On each turn, consider the full conversation and cached result summaries. Reuse cached results only when their domain and subject match the request. If the user adds criteria, retrieve the closest compatible result, apply the matching filter, and save the updated result. Do not filter unrelated results; search for a requested entity or category that the cached results do not cover. Avoid retrieving unrelated results or repeating constraints in filters that were already applied. Save each newly generated search or transformation result under a unique cache key. Use “No planning needed” only when cached results already satisfy every current request.
